name: web-task-agent
description: Local-first, evidence-backed web research workflows with durable state and decision packages

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:receipt-core && npm run typecheck:web-verifier && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run validate:mcp-registry && npm run security:baseline && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:mcp-sdk && npm run test:conformance && npm run check:generated
scripts.security:review: npm run build && npm run security:baseline && node --test dist/tests/receipt-core.test.js dist/tests/interop.test.js dist/tests/web-verifier.test.js dist/tests/demo.test.js dist/tests/source-policy.test.js dist/tests/publication-secret-audit.test.js dist/tests/mcp.test.js dist/tests/reviewer-study-web.test.js && npm run test:conformance && npm run audit:secrets && npm run audit:prod
scripts.test:conformance: npm run build:receipt-core && node scripts/run-receipt-conformance.mjs && node scripts/run-schema-conformance.mjs
scripts.generate:interop: npm run build && node scripts/generate-interop-fixture.mjs && node scripts/generate-authentic-interop.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run audit:secrets && npm run audit:prod && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.check:generated: node scripts/generate-workflow-examples.mjs && node scripts/generate-demo-receipts.mjs && node scripts/generate-golden-paths.mjs && node scripts/generate-interop-fixture.mjs && node scripts/generate-authentic-interop.mjs && node scripts/evaluate-receipts.mjs && node scripts/generate-receipt-spec-examples.mjs && node scripts/build-web-verifier.mjs && node scripts/generate-web-verifier-fixtures.mjs && node scripts/generate-reviewer-study.mjs && node scripts/sync-receipt-spec.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-docs.mjs --check && npm run check:links && git diff --exit-code -- docs site examples/workflows examples/receipts examples/golden-paths examples/interop examples/receipt-spec evaluation packages/decision-receipt/schema packages/decision-receipt/conformance packages/decision-receipt/examples studies
